title: Euler's Identity
description: e to the power iπ, plus one, is nothing: the constants of growth, of the circle, of the imaginary, of one and of none, in a single line. Unlocks Euler's Identity.

puzzle.goal: A point at r·e^(iθ) in the complex plane has turned through θ round a circle of radius r. Write how far up from the axis it is, Y.
puzzle.name: Imaginary part
puzzle.ask: Find Y for r = @{r} and θ = @{θ} (π/6).
puzzle.method: e^(iθ) = cos θ + i·sin θ: the height is the sine. At θ = π the height is 0 and the point is at −1: e^(iπ) = −1.
